description: Cross-database replication: a command line on a git-tracked configuration repository, and the engine a Runner runs. Needs the .NET 10 runtime (and SDK, to restore driver libraries).
notes: A command line on a Sync configuration repository (dbdatasync script test, provisioning plan, library, driver, lineage, package publish --to runner) and, as the dbdatasync-runtime package, the engine a Runner starts for the replications' tasks. The Sync server was deleted (plan 33 SC23): replications are authored in a sync project of the Workspace and published from there to a Runner, which runs them.
